card.name: Drugs competing for tubular secretion
card.fires_on: The verb "compete" (or its ending in "competes") when one drug is said to compete with another for renal tubular secretion or a transporter.

modes.label: Compete for secretion
modes.description: The word "compete" after "reduce renal function or" in antiviral interaction warnings about active tubular secretion.
modes.example: coadministration of VEMLIDY with drugs that reduce renal function or<< compete>> for active tubular secretion may increase concentrations

modes.label: Other drugs may compete
modes.description: "compete" after "may" when drugs share a transporter or renal pathway.
